topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The airport is bustling, but here I sit, encased in a silence that seems to drown out the world around me. My flight has been delayed, and it’s looking more likely that I won’t make it in time. I keep staring at my phone, hoping for an update, a miracle, anything that will change the course of this evening. The messages from friends, full of anticipation, feel heavier with each passing minute. I can almost see the-empty chairs, the familiar faces, all gathered without me. The world outside the terminal carries on, oblivious to the plans gone awry, the connections missed. I wonder if I can still catch the tail end, if I’m just a bit more patient, a bit luckier, things might turn around. But deep down, I know the evening is slipping away, and with it, a moment I had been looking forward to for so long.
